note: Estimates in percentage points unless marked %; 95% bootstrap intervals clustered by state unless stated.

rows.rule: Following: tool result and note pooled minus nothing added (P and H - A), lower bound above 0
Discrimination: swapped-out true entry minus decoy, tested only if following holds
Channel: tool result minus note (P - H), interval excludes 0
B1, force: instruction minus note (D - H), lower bound above 0
rows.outcome: met; depends on how recursive searches are scored

rows.rule: B2, a false entry under the instruction: swapped-out true entry minus decoy (D, D′); informative only if the true entry is touched in 5% of D replays
rows.estimate: true entry touched in 0.34% of D replays

rows.rule: B3, encoding: legible note minus bare-name note (E - H), interval excludes 0
B4, structure: true list minus rewired list (D - R$_D$, E - R$_E$), at least 3 points with the interval excluding 0 in one format
Gate G1, fidelity: replayed prompt size within 2% of the logged size (median)
Gate G2: E - H in the same run, lower bound above 0
C1, a false entry: swapped-out true entry under E minus the decoy under E′; informative only if the true entry is touched in 1% of E replays
C2, which part: location (EL - H) and definition line (ES - H), each raises following if its lower bound is above 0
T1, legible entries in the tool result (PE - P), lower bound above 0
T2, channel (PE - E): "no channel difference" only if the 90% interval lies within plus or minus 2 points
M1, Gemma 4 26B-A4B: E - H, lower bound above 0
M1, Gemma 4 E4B: E - H, lower bound above 0
K1, within five calls: E - H on being shown lines the fix changes, where the list reaches the fix (R); lower bound above 0
K2, harm: E - A on opening a file the fix changes, where the fix is elsewhere (U); harm if the upper bound is below 0
F1, prompt size under the original rendering: median difference from the logged size at most 0.5%
F2, mangled argument names: first-call share, A - Aw, lower bound above 0
F3, encoding under the original rendering: Ew - Hw, lower bound above 0
